title: Account History Rule: Earlier Payment Plans and the Installment Count
content:
The Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program reads the customer's earlier payment plan requests on the program when it sets the number of installments of a new plan.

**Rule.** A payment plan request on the program received within the last 12 calendar months that now stands withdrawn takes 1 installment off, even when another received in that span now stands completed; one received within that span that now stands completed, with none received in it standing withdrawn, adds 2 installments; and otherwise the count is left as it is; a date falls within the last 12 calendar months when it is later than the same calendar day 12 months earlier.

| Payment plan requests on the program received within the last 12 calendar months | Change to the installment count |
|---|---|
| at least one now standing withdrawn (whether or not another now stands completed) | 1 taken off |
| none standing withdrawn, at least one now standing completed | 2 added |
| none standing withdrawn or completed | none |

The request's received date places it in or out of the 12 months; its present status decides which row applies.

**Example (hypothetical).** A count of 6 with a plan request received this spring that now stands withdrawn becomes 5; with only a completed one it becomes 8.
